dedupe_keys.name: enliten wecc and npcc grid economic data and cases

description: The University of Tennessee Knoxville publishes ENLITEN economic data and MATPOWER cases for the western and northeastern US electricity systems. The repository derives generator aggregations, fuel costs, capacities and line ratings from 2020 operational sources, with year-long hourly bus loads and prices. It includes coordinates, source-data documentation, cost preparation and price-comparison scripts. Excel and MATLAB files are available through GitHub and two Figshare archives. Access is free, with CC BY 4.0 stated on Figshare and GPL-3.0 in the GitHub project. The package directly supports economic dispatch and locational-price simulations with model-matpower. A caveat is that aggregated generators and buses simplify the real network, and the supplied simulated prices should not be treated as observed market settlements. The two distribution points state different licences, so users should retain the terms for the version they obtain. No archives or numerical cases were downloaded or run.
